source.name: Shift+Tab from the first control in a modal must wrap to the modal's last control
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/28481) at 85364745831ba5513ee7e940fe571cb4268810b8. Blind to the maintainers' fix 7646f6bd33a03132e446fb060880bbf051a1639f; routing auto.

journey.title: Move backwards through the delete confirmation
journey.goal: Shift+Tab from the first control wraps to the Delete button

functionalJourney.title: Delete the project with the mouse
functionalJourney.goal: Confirming deletes the project and closes the modal

guards.title: Tab forwards through the confirmation and cancel
guards.goal: Forward Tab order reaches Cancel, which closes the modal

plan.root_cause: Focus trap returns focus to the modal element when Shift+Tab leaves the modal, preventing wrap to the last focusable button.
plan.repair_strategy: Add keydown listeners to the first (#confirm-close) and last (#confirm-delete) focusable elements inside the modal to wrap focus within the modal, and remove them on hide.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Shift+Tab from the first control (close button) now moves focus to the Delete button, allowing reverse navigation within the modal while keeping focus trapped.
functional_risks: If other modals use the same element IDs, listeners could affect unintended modals.
If the modal markup changes and the IDs are missing, the listeners will not be attached, leaving original behavior unchanged.
Improper cleanup could cause duplicate listeners if hide is called multiple times without show.
verification_requirements: After opening the modal, pressing Shift+Tab when the close button is focused should move focus to the Delete button.
After opening the modal, pressing Tab when the Delete button is focused should move focus to the close button.
Focus should remain trapped inside the modal; pressing Tab/Shift+Tab repeatedly should cycle only among the modal's focusable elements.
Modal opening, closing, and the delete action (setting status to 'Deleted') should continue to work as before.
